how_to: This file is the handshake between the CEO page's advice and the account.
Fill it once after placing the order: recorded_by = who recorded, asof = YYYY-MM-DD.
placements entries: instrument (e.g. GC001), amount_cny, rate_pct (the rate you got), rate_date.
A row with instrument 'demand' counts as NOT placed (current account), so leave idle cash out.
The page reconciles every round: idle = book cash - sum(placements); gap priced from the repo panel.
notes: Empty on purpose. Nothing in this repo can read the account, so an absent or unfilled record must read as UNRECORDED (gap unknown), never as a comfortable zero.
